name: Flying Founders
decision_note: Prague vehicle of founders Zdenko Zvada and Michal Truban that invests its own capital (EUR 100-500k, growth capital and buyouts, held for dividends) in profitable Czech/Slovak SaaS companies (Tolgee 2024, Tiny Empires acquisition Sept 2025) - a private investor between VC and PE, not a VC fund.

evidence.quote: We invest our own capital, roll up our sleeves, and stay as long as it takes - without an exit agenda.
Up to €500k for bootstrapped founders between €100k–€2m ARR.
Nový fond tak funguje na pomezí venture kapitálu nebo private equity, kdy investuje přímo výměnou za podíl ve firmě.
Flying Founders již za sebou mají i první investici – brněnský nástroj Tolgee, který se zaměřuje na jazykovou lokalizaci softwaru.
I am excited to share that Tiny Empires has been acquired by Flying Founders and will join their growing portfolio of SaaS businesses!
Cílem fondu Flying Founders je pomoci zakladatelům stavět rostoucí a hlavně profitabilní slovenské i české firmy postavené na modelu SaaS, tedy software jako služba.

analyst_notes: Second-pass screen. Type: the site says 'We invest our own capital' with 'no LP forcing an exit' and long-term holding for dividends (e1); CzechCrunch places the model between VC and PE, including partial buyouts of founders and earlier investors (e4) - private_investor (own capital), consistent with Miton/Gi21 Capital; secondary vc. Flying Founders s.r.o. (IČO 21828377, Praha 8, est. 2024-07-17; executive Zdenko Zvada; partners Trantor, s.r.o. (SK) and Onsight Partners s.r.o.). Ticket: site EUR 100-500k once (CzechCrunch 2024 said EUR 100-600k). Stage derived from target ARR EUR 100k-2m (revenue-stage SaaS, seed to growth). Activity: Tiny Empires (founder newsletter business) acquired 2025-09-17 - an acquisition, recorded as round 'buyout'; Tolgee (Brno) was the first investment, closed before the 2024-09-03 article (exact date unknown, left null). Michal Truban states he handed management fully to Zvada.
